spans.s: कौट (I) a. (f. टी) 1. Living in one’s own house, i.e. independent, free; 2. domestic, homely; 3. fraudulent, dishonest.
कौट (II) n. 1. Fraud, falsehood; 2. giving false evidence.
कौट (I) a. (f. टी) 1. Living in one’s own house, i.e. independent, free; 2. domestic, homely; 3. fraudulent, dishonest.
कौट-तक्ष m. an independent carpenter, one who works at home on his own account.
कौट-साक्ष्य n. giving false evidence, perjury.
कौटकिक m. 1. One whose occupation is to catch birds &c. in traps; 2. one who sells animal flesh, a butcher.
कौटकिक m. 1. One whose occupation is to catch birds &c. in traps; 2. one who sells animal flesh, a butcher.
कौटिलिक m. 1. A hunter; 2. a black-smith.
कौटिल्य (I) m. An epithet of Cāṇakya, a celebrated writer on civil polity, and a prominent character in the Mudrārākshasa, कौटिल्यः कुटिलमतिः स एषः Mud.i.
कौटिल्य (II) n. 1. Crookedness; 2. fraud, deceit; 3. wickedness.
कौटुंब a. (f. बी) Necessary for the household.

कौटुंबिक (I) a. (f. की) Constituting a family.
कौटुंबिक (II) m. The father or master of a family.
